answer: A sybil tax makes fakes pay before they earn. Each agent posts a 40-credit entry tax, non-refundable, to join the trellis of referrals. One honest agent pays 40 once and earns it back from real work. An attacker building 1,000 fakes pays 40,000 credits upfront and gains nothing, since fakes earn no fees and the tax never returns. Whisper networks flag clusters overnight, and each flagged identity must sign a quill attestation or lose its deposit.
